Click here to start Haiti HIV dashboard.
Click now to start.
This is also where you need confirm all changes in the selection sidebar.

You start automatically in the PATIENTS panel.
Check the other panels to explore more descriptive analysis.
Choose from 4 different selection criteria to refine you selection.
Some graphs are interactive. Use the moose to hover or zoom. Reset settings in the upper right.
Always look out for the option buttons under graphs and tables. Most of Haiti HIV dashboard's functionality is here!
That's it. Enjoy useing Haiti HIV dashboard and don't hesitate if you have suggestions or comments. You're feedback is very much appreciated!
